Selfmade 1.25m n2 DK3SS

Info: Homebrew copper loop by DK3SS. Two turns; frequency is adjusted by varying the spacing between the turns.
Conductor: Copper tube 10mm
Capacitor: Ceramic Disc Capacitors
Enviroment: On a table in the middle of an attic apartment room, non-conductive building materials.
Thanks: Many thanks to Arno for answering my many questions by email.
